snippet.title: Cold Iron - The Blasting Company ft. Jemaine Clement | Official Lyric Video | Crooked Moon
snippet.description:
The fifth single from the Crooked Moon soundtrack featuring Jemaine Clement as Yorgrim, the Chained Reaper. Discover the story of Yorgrim in *The Crooked Moon,* a 632-page Folk Horror tome for 5E. Pre-order today: https://thecrookedmoon.com

🔗 Cold Iron is streaming on all platforms!
https://open.spotify.com/track/7cIiDRlrWoQ2ABKWTXTl2E?si=317cbbd542c1470e

Song by   @BlastingCompany . 

Written by: Josh Ross Kaufman & Justin Rubenstein
Produced by: The Blasting Company
Mixed by Satoshi Noguchi
Mastered by Tom Rogers

The Band:
Jemaine Clement - Lead Vocal
Leonie Evans - Choir Vocals
Kim Nguyen - Choir Vocals 
Jason Diaz - Choir Vocals
Nick Glaab - Choir Vocals
Stephan Lee - Choir Vocals
Darin Roeung - Choir Vocals
Rae Shrum - Choir Vocals
Michaela Teissere - Choir Vocals
Eliana Athayde - Double Bass
Austin Hoke - Cello
Heather Lockie - Viola
Kathryn Beers - Bassoon
Kristin Weber - VIolin
Justin Rubenstein - Trombone, Choir Vocals, Percussion
J.R. Kaufman - Clarinet, Flute

Animated by Jesse Chantz.

*Lyrics:*

This night just like the last one
Falls heavy as a stone 
And stone by stone this gathered dark
Is mine to bear alone

Impatient wrath surrounds me 
It claws and scrapes these chains 
The same cold irons that bind me 
To my own fate 
Now groan and strain 
As restless death awaits 

The light forever denied 
Quenching our starved and languid eyes 
He’s breaking, you see 
He’s breaking, and we shall feed

For whom have I long suffered 
What good this toilsome charge 
What fool so bound by duty 
Would pay a wage so large

The weight of endless twilights 
The chafing of these chains
The spade that scrapes out lime packed graves 
Shall turn against 
My cold restraints
And we shall feast again

The light, forever denied 
What have I ever stood to gain
Quenching our starved and languid eyes 
Cowering from the dawn just as it’s breaking just as
It's breaking, you see
It's breaking, you see
It's breaking
and we are free

--

snippet.title: Dust to Damnation - Ep. 6 | Wild West Daggerheart Campaign | Ready for Blood
snippet.description:
🗡️❤️We're playing Daggerheart by  @DarringtonPress  for a 3-session mini-campaign in the Colossus of the Drylands campaign frame! Check out this awesome system and use code AVANTRIS for 15% off the Daggerheart Core Set! https://bit.ly/DustDH

The dusty town of Eden nestled in foothills of the Drylands is one hell of a place to make your fortune. Amidst the overwhelming greed and deep-seated superstition of the region, five townsfolk will discover secrets best left forgotten, the price of progress, and whether there is any hope for salvation when Doom comes to the Drylands.

Note: Episode 6 is the second half of our third streamed session of Daggerheart on 11/17/25

Cast:
Game Master - Mikey Gilder
Silas "Shepherd" Morgan - Andy Flynn
Rett Indigo - Richie Gilder
Gideon Coal - Mace Caffrey
Quibly Gones - Derek Hudson

snippet.title: Dust to Damnation - Ep. 3 | Wild West Daggerheart Campaign | A Lie Agreed Upon
snippet.description:
🗡️❤️We're playing Daggerheart by  @DarringtonPress  for a 3-session mini-campaign in the Colossus of the Drylands campaign frame! Check out this awesome system and use code AVANTRIS for 15% off the Daggerheart Core Set! https://bit.ly/DustDH

The dusty town of Eden nestled in foothills of the Drylands is one hell of a place to make your fortune. Amidst the overwhelming greed and deep-seated superstition of the region, five townsfolk will discover secrets best left forgotten, the price of progress, and whether there is any hope for salvation when Doom comes to the Drylands.

Note: Episode 3 is the first half of our second streamed session of Daggerheart on 11/11/25

Cast:
Game Master - Mikey Gilder
Silas "Shepherd" Morgan - Andy Flynn
Rett Indigo - Richie Gilder

snippet.title: [Live] Dust to Damnation Stream 1 (Eps. 1 & 2) | Daggerheart Mini-Campaign | bit.ly/DustDH
snippet.description:
🗡️❤️We're playing Daggerheart by @DarringtonPress for a 3-session mini-campaign in the Colossus of the Drylands campaign frame! Check out this awesome system where GMs and players share the narrative and every choice matters! https://bit.ly/DustDH

The dusty town of Eden nestled in foothills of the Drylands is one hell of a place to make your fortune. Amidst the overwhelming greed and deep-seated superstition of the region, five townsfolk will discover secrets best left forgotten, the price of progress, and whether there is any hope for salvation when Doom comes to the Drylands.

Cast:
Game Master - Mikey Gilder
Silas "Shepherd" Morgan - Andy Flynn
Rett Indigo - Richie Gilder
Gideon Coal - Mace Caffrey
Quibly Gones - Derek Hudson
Portia Bella Gones - Nikkie Pacheco

Character art by Ona Kristensen

Avantris Links:
🎃*The Crooked Moon:* https://thecrookedmoon.com
🔴 *Twitch:* https://www.twitch.tv/legendsofavantris

snippet.title: Light of My Life - The Blasting Company ft. Haley Reinhart | Official Lyric Video | Crooked Moon
snippet.description:
The fifth single from the Crooked Moon soundtrack featuring Haley Reinhart as Lady Adela Druskenvald. Discover the story of Adela in *The Crooked Moon,* a 632-page Folk Horror tome for 5E.  https://thecrookedmoon.com

🔥 Light of My Life is streaming on all platforms!
https://open.spotify.com/track/40EieG74sD8Mvu3nsPtkai?si=0ee38ceffae24190

Song by @BlastingCompany!

@haleyreinhart - Lead Vocals
Kim Nguyen - Harp, Backing Vocals
Eliana Athayde - Contrabass
Dr. Sick - Violin 
Lulu Starr - Violin
Heather Lockie - Viola
Leonie Evans - Backing Vocals
Nick Glaab - Backing Vocals
Rae Shrum - Backing Vocals
Ursula Gueringer - Backing Vocals
Kat Beers - Backing Vocals
Justin Rubenstein - Cello, Backing Vocals
J.R. Kaufman - Clarinet, Accordion, Backing Vocals

Mixed and Mastered by Oz Fritz

Animated by Jesse Chantz

*Lyrics:*

Light of my life
Wrapping me gently 
Leaves gliding upward
Spill into night 

I’ve loved the world
Shaped by these shadows 
Held in the long sweet song
Of time 

Time spent with you 
Under a sky
Framed by the trees
Bursting with light

Time could have stopped there but then
Leaves shuddered still
Wind hummed along 
Our beautiful world
Moving to its own song 

(Fire rising, wrest our breath away
Fill the skies with the songs we’ve borrowed
Flesh and senses born of clay
Fill the fields where your bounty lays) 

(Fire rising, wrest our breath away)
Carry me through the night
(Fill the skies with the songs we’ve borrowed)
My glowing ember
(Flesh and senses born of clay)
Light his face so that I
(Fill the fields where your bounty lays)
Can remember 

(Fire rising, wrest our breath away)
Carry me through the night
(Fill the skies with the songs we’ve borrowed)
My glowing ember
(Flesh and senses born of clay)
Light his face so that I
(Fill the fields where your bounty lays)
Can remember 

(La la la la 
La la la la
La la la la
La la la la)

What is the use
Spending this last tear
How does it make this more
Painless to bear

In the blink of an eye 
All will be bone dry 
Drunk by this smoke-veiled
Flickering life

Life spent with you
Under a sky
Framed by the trees
Bursting with light
Time should have stopped there, but then...

--

snippet.title: Under Your Shadow - The Blasting Company ft. Ramin Karimloo | Official Lyric Video | Crooked Moon
snippet.description:
The fourth single from the Crooked Moon soundtrack featuring Ramin Karimloo as Father Renathyr. Discover the story of Father Renathyr in *The Crooked Moon,* a 632-page Folk Horror tome for 5E. https://thecrookedmoon.com

🦇 Under Your Shadow is streaming on all platforms!
https://open.spotify.com/track/4ndzCwHkjo9fkN6jbSqNlB?si=6648f51c23954b01

Song by  @BlastingCompany. 

Ramin Karimloo - Lead Vocal 
Austin Hoke - Cello
J.R. Kaufman - Pipe Organ 
Justin Rubenstein - Timpani, Choir Vocals (Tenor)
Jason Diaz - Choir Vocals (Tenor)
Nick Glaab - Choir Vocals (Bass)
Stephan Lee - Choir Vocals (Tenor)
Kim Nguyen - Choir Vocals (Soprano)
Darin Roeung - Choir Vocals (Bass)
Rae Shrum - Choir Vocals (Alto)
Michaela Teissere - Choir Vocals (Alto)

Animated by Jesse Chantz.

*Lyrics:*

Bear me
Under your shadow
Sweet as night
No light can pierce me through
Nobody sees me 
As you do

Stand now
Bloodless, unburdened
Drained of fear
No more must we be shamed for
The dread behind 
Our tears

Hear me, trust me
See me, love me
Fear me, judge me
I love you

Who else can know
All of your pain
Who do you know
Could carry their shame
As long as you have
But never again

For I
Am filled by endless love
And suffering for you

Hear me! 
See me!

Who but I knows
God’s true gift
What thin black crape 
Her love portends
With hearts agape
Come souls afflicted 
I shall fill your house with all 
Her cold and hollow truth

Bear me
Under your shadow
Sweet as night

No more light
Shall pierce us through
No one can love you
As I do

Trust me
Fear me 

--

snippet.title: By the Lagoon - The Blasting Company ft. Jerron Paxton | Official Lyric Video | The Crooked Moon
snippet.description:
The second single from the Crooked Moon soundtrack featuring Jerron Paxton as Mr. Crossroads. Discover the story of Mr. Crossroads in *The Crooked Moon,* a 632-page Folk Horror tome for 5E. Pre-order today: https://thecrookedmoon.com

🐊By the Lagoon is streaming on all platforms!
https://open.spotify.com/track/33ieR2IolQ9PY8bPQbTFac?si=4b42810ca1ae4a41

Song by  @BlastingCompany 

Jerron Paxton - Lead Vocals
Eliana Athayde - Double Bass
Andrew Cohen - Tuba
Dominique Rodriguez - Drums
Justin Rubenstein - Guitar, Trumpet, Trombone, Backup Vocals
J.R. Kaufman - Clarinet, Piano, Backup Vocals

Animated by Jesse Chantz.

*Lyrics:*

Two roads 
With no beginning
Cross where the water’s low 
The ground isn’t dry but it holds up just fine
Under toe

Don’t mind me 
I’m leaving soon
Wish I could say the same for you
Isn’t it nice here
By the lagoon
It’s never too late
To take in the view

Now what’s that
Gliding in the water 
Blank eyes drifting above
If you see any of that
Little alligator smile
Good luck 

Just one thing
Before I go 
I know there's a place
Just down the road
It could be nice there
A place to unwind
Far from livin'
So close to dyin'

What kind of happiness
Would be your happiest
What is that one regret
That you must get off your chest
What are you so afraid of losing
That you’d lose everything

And there she is rolling by
Steam glowin' in gloomy light 
Just follow my lead and I
Will get you on board alive
But isn’t it nice here
By the lagoon 
If you’d rather stay
And take in the view

--

snippet.title: Dead Trees - The Blasting Company ft. Ekaterina Shelehova | Official Lyric Video | The Crooked Moon
snippet.description:
The third single from the Crooked Moon soundtrack featuring Ekaterina Shelehova as Gorthos. Discover the story of the Beast of Blight in *The Crooked Moon,* a 632-page Folk Horror tome for 5E. Pre-order today: https://thecrookedmoon.com

🦌Dead Trees is streaming on all platforms! https://open.spotify.com/track/72Ac5XLqnmX8fMUYmSEBsU?si=55a8fc6e814a4abf

Song by @BlastingCompany

Ekaterina Shelehova - Lead Vocals (Gorthos), Backing Vocals 
Eliana Athayde - Double Bass
Cory Beers - Tapan
Siobhán Hogan - Uilleann Pipes
Kim Nguyen - Harp
Justin Rubenstein - Cello, Nyckelharpa, Classical Guitar, Whistle
J.R. Kaufman - Hurdy Gurdy, Classical Guitar, Whistle, Backing Vocals

Animated by Jesse Chantz.

*Lyrics:*

Dead trees
Open up for me
Teeming
With all these crawling thieves
Gnashing and scratching
Over your rotted rings

Dead leaves
Make a bed for me
Tonight
Where I may fall asleep
Dreaming of morning
When I shall mourn for thee

Judge me not for what I’ve become
There’s nothing
More left to be done
All that remains
Is long dead and gone

Heavy
Sighs the rusted breeze
Dragging
Over sunken peat
Roses once blood-bloomed
Wither in ashen heaps

Buried
All these fleshed dreams
No more
Fighting night with their heat
Slack and receding
Cold as the earth where they sleep

Judge me not
My jury of bones
Glaring
From eyes gray as stone
Justice in black
Seeps from her rotting throne

Judge me not for what I’ve become
There’s nothing
More left to be done
All that remains
Is long dead and gone

snippet.title: Coal Eyed Birds - The Blasting Company | Official Animated Lyric Video | The Crooked Moon
snippet.description:
The first single from the Crooked Moon soundtrack featuring the story of Raum, the Harvest Terror. Pre-order your copy of *The Crooked Moon,* a 500+ page Folk Horror tome for 5E: https://thecrookedmoon.backerkit.com/hosted_preorders

🎃Coal Eyed Birds is streaming on all platforms! 
https://open.spotify.com/track/59LlX0f9gs7yQaNjNFi1sC?si=690b732e4cb24c55

Song by @BlastingCompany

Frank Fairfield - Vocals (Jericho), Guitar, 5-String Banjo
Eliana Athayde - Contrabass
Andrew Cohen (Accordionist) - Tuba
David Elsenbroich - Tenor Banjo, Backup Vocals
Dominique Rodriguez - Drums
Justin Rubenstein - Vocals (Virgil), Trombone, Trumpet, Backup Vocals
JR Kaufman - Clarinet, Piano, Backup Vocals

Animated by Rae Gonzalez: https://x.com/axeleraey

*Lyrics:*

Under a sunken sky
Five coal eyed birds
Huddle in the sallow weeds
Cackling at me

And it’s times like these
I hang my head
And wonder why I never try to
To fight for myself

What a grim and gloomy scene
Just you, the wind, the dying wheat
Friendless, dreaming

You wonder if you’re incomplete
A husk without a grain of seed
And that’s what they see

If they wanna laugh, well now
Let them try to do it after 
We take to the skies

Loom above them like a great cloud
Talons quicker than a greyhound 
Hear their hearts run

Out of all the things
I’ve seen and done
In the back of my worried mind
I’ve never tried one

Maybe this time I
Could make them see
They’ve probably never met a threat 
As empty as me

If they wanna laugh, well now 
Can they do it while they beg me
To spare their souls

Funny how they keep singing
Little empty bodies leaping
To the snap of their bones 

La-La-La-La-La-La
La-La-La-La-La-La
La-La-La-La

La-La-La-La-La
La-La-La-La-La-La
La-La-La-La

Under a sunken sky
Two coal eyed birds
Huddle in the flattened wheat
Staring up at me

—

snippet.description:

🚀*Neon Odyssey*, our Space Opera trilogy for D&D 5E, is *coming to Kickstarter this May*! Become a VIP to unlock *free Neon Nights dice* and other exclusive rewards: https://avantr.is/neon-rpg-yt

Music: @BlastingCompany

Vocals: @leonieevans 

Animation: @julianocastro 

Illustration: Humble Squid Creatives, Holly Lucero

Lyrics: 

Hungry woods reaching high
Snatch the light out from the sky
Leafy sighs, creaking bones
Pray you don't get found alone

Crickly crack, the branches pop
Here crawls the night that never stops
A tree there leans with twisted grin
Her limbs are thrawn, her soul is sin

Underneath the Crooked Moon
Stalks the King on cloven hoof
In pale decay and empty gloom
He comes for you

Six horns his crown, his kingdom all
For life delicious heed his call
He carries six of sword and seal
Once wayward souls, the Fallen kneel

Run, run, don't shrink and cower
And join us at the witching hour
We'll skip and sing in thrashing light
To smother the shrieks of endless night

Dance beneath the Crooked Moon
Round rising rapture, hand in hand
From pale decay and empty gloom
We'll comfort you

May our light embrace you too
And pierce the Edge of Midnight soon
Through wicker's blaze and ashen plume
The Crooked Moon

snippet.title: League of Legends D&D One-Shot | Heart's Desire - A Bilgewater Tale
snippet.description:
Welcome to Bilgewater, an unscrupulous port city unlike anywhere else in Runeterra. It’s as lawless as the sea and the wind that surround it and that’s the way the sinners and scoundrels that live there like it. It’s one hell of a place to make your fortune, and it can be made in the blink of an eye, just as fast as your ambitions can be shattered, sending it down the drain into the chum-filled Bloodharbor.  Here in Bilgewater, if you have coin, you can seek out whatever your heart desires, and you’ll probably find it. But remember, everything has a price.
